units.source_text: 年来柏木对于落叶公主，心底里并无深挚的爱情，

en.t: For years, Kashiwagi had felt no deep love in his heart for Princess Ochiba,

units.source_text: 但在表面上，非常恭谨尊重，亲爱逾恒，关怀周至，

en.t: but outwardly he was very courteous and respectful, showed more affection than usual, and cared for her attentively,
so that they had always treated each other with the respect due to honored guests.

units.source_text: 因此落叶公主对他并无怨恨之处。

en.t: Because of this, Princess Ochiba had no cause to resent him.

units.source_text: 她看见柏木如此寿短，只觉得世事不可思议，人生实在无聊，

en.t: Seeing Kashiwagi die so young, she could only feel that the ways of the world were unfathomable and that life was truly empty,

units.source_text: 左思右想，不胜悲戚，那迷离恍惚的神情实甚可怜。

en.t: and as she turned it over and over in her mind, she was overcome with grief; her dazed, bewildered look was deeply pitiful.

units.source_text: 她的母夫人想起女儿青春守寡，惹人讪笑，不胜惋惜。

en.t: Her mother thought of her daughter widowed in youth and exposed to people's mockery, and could not help feeling bitter regret.

units.source_text: 看了女儿愁苦的模样，感到无限悲恸。

en.t: When she saw her daughter's sorrowful state, she was filled with boundless grief.

units.source_text: 柏木的父母更不必说，他们恋恋不舍地哭泣，叫道：“应该让我们先死呀！

en.t: As for Kashiwagi's parents, there was no need to say more: they wept inconsolably and cried, "We should have been allowed to die first!
This world is far too unreasonable!"
Yet there was nothing that could be done.

units.source_text: 做了尼姑的三公主一向痛恨柏木无礼，希望他不得长寿。

en.t: The Third Princess, who had become a nun, had always hated Kashiwagi's insolence and had wished that he would not live long.

units.source_text: 但闻知他已死去，毕竟也觉得可怜。

en.t: But when she heard that he had died, she still felt pity for him after all.

units.source_text: 她心中推想：“柏木相信这孩子是他的儿子，所以我和他想必确有前世因缘，才发生那桩意外的祸事吧。”

en.t: In her heart she reflected, "Kashiwagi believed that this child was his son, so he and I must indeed have been bound by karma from a previous life, and that is why that unexpected misfortune occurred."

units.source_text: 她左思右想，不胜感伤，不知不觉地流下泪来。

en.t: As she pondered it again and again, she was overcome with sadness and, before she knew it, tears began to fall.
